caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical container with a lid, positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background with no other objects present. The container is reddish-orange in color and features decorative patterns in yellow and black. The top of the lid is adorned with a symmetrical floral or starburst motif in yellow and black, with a central small circular black area. Below the lid, a yellow garland-like design with droplet shapes hangs around the upper portion of the container. Near the base, there is another band of yellow decoration. The lines and contours are clearly defined, and there is visible shading to suggest the three-dimensional form of the object. A signature is present in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Toleware Sugar Bowl
